approvalMode: {agent} is now in {mode, select, auto {auto} other {manual}} mode, from {surface, select, telegram {Telegram} console {the console} mini {the Mini App} cli {the CLI} other {binference}}
frozen: 🔴 {agent} is frozen from {surface, select, telegram {Telegram} console {the console} mini {the Mini App} cli {the CLI} other {binference}}. Unfreeze in the CLI, the console or the Mini App.
unfrozen: 🟢 {scope, select, install {Every agent is unfrozen} other {{agent} is unfrozen}} from {surface, select, telegram {Telegram} console {the console} mini {the Mini App} cli {the CLI} other {binference}}.
locked: 🔴 binference restarted and is locked. Run `binference unlock`.
signerStopped: 🔴 The signer stopped, so binference signs nothing. Fix what `binference logs` shows, then run `binference unlock`.
signerRefused: ⚠️ The signer refused to sign a step of a trade: {rule, select, unknown_request {it was no request the signer knows} malformed {the request could not be read} rule_1 {its chain is not enabled, or is not the transaction's} rule_2 {it calls a contract the trade may not use} rule_3 {its amounts are not the trade's} rule_4 {it asks for a kind of signature the signer never gives} rule_5 {the confirmation or the grant behind it ran out, or does not match} rule_6 {it is no plain speed-up or cancel of the step} other {it broke one of the signer's rules}}. Nothing was sent for it.
privyUnreachable: 🔴 binference could not reach Privy for five minutes after it started, so it stays locked. Check this machine's network, then run `binference unlock`.
backupFailed: ⚠️ Last night's backup failed: {reason, select, no_owner_key {binference holds no owner key to seal it to} snapshot {a database could not be copied} write {the backup file could not be written; check the disk's free space} check {reading it back found a part that does not match} copy {its second copy in backups.copyTo could not be written} other {an unexpected fault stopped it; `binference logs` shows it}}
unknownTx: ⚠️ {wallet}'s nonce {nonce} was used by a transaction binference did not sign
fillDiffers: ⚠️ A trade settled more than 1% away from its simulation. Check the trade.
blockShared: ⚠️ Two trades of {wallet} landed in one block, so its positions and P&L may count the coin that block paid it twice. Check the wallet.
fillUnknown: ⚠️ A trade settled, but no RPC can say what it received any more. Add a tracing RPC to the config and restart binference to finish it.
notSigned: ⚠️ A trade was cancelled before its first transaction was signed. Nothing was sent.
confirmationLapsed: ⚠️ A trade was not sent: its confirmation ran out before it could go out. Nothing was signed.
feeAboveCap: ⚠️ A trade waited because the network fee was above your cap, and its confirmation ran out. Confirm it again on its new card, or cancel it.
launchUnsent: ⚠️ A trade on a launch's curve was not sent: {reason, select, launch_unread {binference could not read the launch from its launchpad} other {the launchpad no longer holds the token on that curve, as after its graduation}}. Nothing was signed.
launchStopped: ⚠️ The launch of {symbol} on {venue} stopped: {reason, select, pin_failed {the launchpad could not pin its picture and words} pin_timeout {the launchpad did not pin its picture and words within 5 minutes} upload_lost {it stopped while the launchpad took its picture and words} engine_stopping {binference stopped before its card opened, and its plan is now too old to show} other {the launchpad's steps failed a check}}. Nothing was signed, but its picture and words may be public on the launchpad. Propose the launch again if you still want it.
stepUnsent: ⚠️ A trade stopped part way: an earlier step landed on chain, but a later one was never signed. Check the wallet.
stepDropped: ⚠️ A trade was stuck and did not go through. Nothing moved, and the wallet is free again.
stepDroppedPartWay: ⚠️ A trade stopped part way: an earlier step landed on chain, but a later one was stuck and did not go through. The wallet is free again. Check the wallet.
droppedLanded: 🔴 A trade binference reported as stuck went through after all. binference has now counted it toward your limits and positions. Check the wallet.
walletHeld: ⚠️ A transaction of {wallet} is stuck, so the wallet's later trades wait behind it. binference keeps sending it until a block holds it or every relay drops it.
rescueStopped: 🔴 A rescue stopped part way: the rescue address changed while it ran. What was not sent stays in the wallets. Check them, then start a rescue again.
rescueAddress: ⚠️ Rescue address changes to {address} at {when}. Not you? Cancel now.
lowGas: ⚠️ {wallet} has {balance} left for network fees. Add BNB.
sendLevelCancelled: Send level change to {to} cancelled; it stays {level}
ceilingOutdated: ⚠️ The wallets' ceilings still let sends pay {address}. Run `binference rescue set` with the owner key to update them.
ceilingChange: ⚠️ The owner key changed the ceiling of {agent}'s wallets from {surface, select, telegram {Telegram} console {the console} mini {the Mini App} cli {the CLI} other {binference}}: {change, select, venues {the venues a contract call may use} cap {the most one contract call may carry} dayCaps {the 24-hour caps every wallet shares} other {the venues a contract call may use, and the most it may carry}}. Not you? Freeze now.
signerRevoked: ⚠️ The owner key removed the agent key of signer {signer} from every wallet, from {surface, select, telegram {Telegram} console {the console} mini {the Mini App} cli {the CLI} other {binference}}. The machine that held it signs nothing more. Not you? Freeze now.

configInvalid: ⚠️ binference kept the settings it runs on: config.json5 {problem, select, unreadable {cannot be read at line {line}} missing_file {is gone} newer_version {is for a newer binference} older_version {is for an older binference; run `binference check --fix`} unknown_key {has a key binference does not know, {key}} required {lacks {key}} bad_value {has a value {key} does not take} bad_key {has a key name {key} does not take} secret_inline {holds a secret as plain text at {key}} other {has a problem at {key}}}. newDevice: A new console device was paired: {label}
signInsLocked: ⚠️ Too many failed attempts to sign in {what, select, address {from {name}} local {over this machine's local connection} device {with the console device {name}} token {with the client token {name}} miniApp {from the Mini App} other {with a credential binference does not know}}, so binference refuses them until {until}. plainSecret: ⚠️ A secret is written as plain text in config. Run `binference check --fix`.
budget: {agent} used today's model budget ({budget}). Chat resumes {when}; orders keep running.
scheduleSet: New schedule for {agent}, set {by, select, agent {by the agent} telegram {from Telegram} console {from the console} mini {from the Mini App} cli {from the CLI} other {in binference}}, next run {next}: {prompt}
